description: This file defines the 'User' result class for the Coocook schema, including database table mapping, relationships, and user-related methods such as password verification, role management, and email validation.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::User
classes.description: Result class representing users in the Coocook database schema, including columns, relationships, and user-related methods.

methods.name: alternative_email_valid_and_available
methods.description: Checks if the user's alternative email is valid and not used by other users.

methods.name: blacklist
methods.description: Adds the user's email and username to blacklist tables within a transaction.

methods.name: check_password
methods.description: Verifies a provided password against the stored salted hash.

methods.name: check_base64_token
methods.description: Verifies a base64-encoded token against the stored token hash, considering expiration.

methods.name: add_roles
methods.description: Assigns one or multiple roles to the user.

methods.name: has_any_role
methods.description: Checks if the user has any of the specified roles.

methods.name: has_any_project_role
methods.description: Determines if the user has specific roles on a given project or through organization memberships.

methods.name: has_any_organization_role
methods.description: Checks if the user has any of the specified roles within an organization.

methods.name: is_member_of
methods.description: Checks if the user is a member of a specific organization.

methods.name: roles
methods.description: Returns a list of roles assigned to the user.

methods.name: status_code
methods.description: Returns the status code of the user based on verification and token expiration.

methods.name: status_description
methods.description: Provides a textual description of the user's status.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Determines the overall status of the user, such as verified, unverified, or password recovery.
